import Mathlib

open Polynomial

/--
Let $K$ be the splitting field of a irreducible quintic polynomial $f(x) \in \mathbb{Q} [x]$
and let $\{\alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_5\}$ be zeros of $f(x)$ in $K$. Show that if $\mathbb{Q}
(\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3) \neq K$, then $\\mathrm{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong S_5$.
-/
theorem nonempty_gal_mulEquiv_perm_fin_five {f : ℚ[X]} {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    [IsSplittingField ℚ K f] (hf1 : Irreducible f) (hf2 : f.natDegree = 5) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : K)
    (ha1 : a₁ ∈ rootSet f K ∧ a₂ ∈ rootSet f K ∧ a₃ ∈ rootSet f K)
    (ha2 : a₁ ≠ a₂ ∧ a₂ ≠ a₃ ∧ a₃ ≠ a₁)
    (h : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {a₁, a₂, a₃} ≠ ⊤) :
    Nonempty (f.Gal ≃* (Equiv.Perm <| Fin 5)) := by

and let $\{\alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_5\}$ be zeros of $f(x)$ in $K$. Show that if $\mathbb{Q}

theorem nonempty_gal_mulEquiv_perm_fin_five {f : ℚ[X]} {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    [IsSplittingField ℚ K f] (hf1 : Irreducible f) (hf2 : f.natDegree = 5) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : K)
    (ha1 : a₁ ∈ rootSet f K ∧ a₂ ∈ rootSet f K ∧ a₃ ∈ rootSet f K)
    (ha2 : a₁ ≠ a₂ ∧ a₂ ≠ a₃ ∧ a₃ ≠ a₁)
    (h : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {a₁, a₂, a₃} ≠ ⊤) :
    Nonempty (f.Gal ≃* (Equiv.Perm <| Fin 5)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ha1
  obtain ⟨n12, n23, n31⟩ := ha2
  have key5 : ∀ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), ∀ x y z : Fin 5, x ≠ y → y ≠ z → x ≠ z → p x = x →

    rw [Polynomial.card_rootSet_eq_natDegree hsep hspl.out, hf2]
  let e : (f.rootSet K) ≃ Fin 5 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
  let c : Equiv.Perm (f.rootSet K) →* Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) :=
    { toFun := fun p => e.permCongr p
      map_one' := by ext x; simp [Equiv.permCongr_apply]
      map_mul' := by intro p q; ext x; simp [Equiv.permCongr_apply] }
  let ψ0 := Polynomial.Gal.galActionHom f K
  let ψ : f.Gal →* Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) := c.comp ψ0
  have hψinj : Function.Injective ψ := by
    intro σ τ hst
    apply Polynomial.Gal.galActionHom_injective f K
    exact (Equiv.permCongr e).injective hst
  have hfix : ∀ σ : f.Gal, ∀ a (ha : a ∈ f.rootSet K), σ a = a →
      ψ σ (e ⟨a, ha⟩) = e ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
    intro σ a ha hσ
    show e (ψ0 σ (e.symm (e ⟨a, ha⟩))) = e ⟨a, ha⟩
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Polynomial.Gal.galActionHom_apply]
    exact hσ

    by_contra hcon
    apply h

      intro σ hσ

        hσ a₃ (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (by simp))⟩

        = IntermediateField.fixedField (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {a₁, a₂, a₃}).fixingSubgroup :=
          (IsGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup _).symm

          rw [hbot]
          refine eq_top_iff.2 (fun x _ => ?_)
          rw [IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
          intro g hg
          rw [Subgroup.mem_bot.1 hg]
          rfl
  obtain ⟨σ0, hσ0ne, hs1, hs2, hs3⟩ := hsw
  have hτne : ψ σ0 ≠ 1 := by
    intro hh
    apply hσ0ne
    apply hψinj
    rw [hh, map_one]

    exact this

    obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hp⟩ := key5 (ψ σ0) (e ⟨a₁, h1⟩) (e ⟨a₂, h2⟩) (e ⟨a₃, h3⟩)

    exact ⟨u, v, huv, hp⟩

    rw [← hd, horb]

    rw [orderOf_injective ψ hψinj g, hg]
  have hcyc : (ψ g).IsCycle :=

      (by rw [hg5]; simp)
  have hsupp : (ψ g).support = Finset.univ := by
    apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card
    have := hcyc.orderOf
    rw [hg5] at this
    simpa using this.symm
  have htop : Subgroup.closure {ψ g, ψ σ0} = ⊤ :=
    Equiv.Perm.closure_prime_cycle_swap (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact Nat.prime_five)

    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨σ0, rfl⟩
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective ψ := by

    have hp : p ∈ Subgroup.closure {ψ g, ψ σ0} := by rw [htop]; trivial
    exact MonoidHom.mem_range.mp (hle hp)
  exact ⟨MulEquiv.ofBijective ψ ⟨hψinj, hsurj⟩⟩
